chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja'far, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Abdillah, from Abdillah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them), said:
Fasting the day of Ashura is an expiation for a year.

key_terms.يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ: The day of Ashura (10th of Muharram)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of fasting on the day of Ashura according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *al-Istibsar*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the day of Ashura (10th of Muharram) as a day of expiation for minor sins over the past year, distinct from its commemoration of Imam Husayn’s martyrdom. This ruling is particularly significant in Shia jurisprudence as it validates the voluntary fast on this day, balancing the historical gravity of the event with personal spiritual purification.
